description: JSON-LD structured data for rich results. Pick with mode: generate = Write JSON-LD for a page: type Article, Product, FAQPage, Organization, BreadcrumbList, VideoObject, Event, Recipe, JobPosting, SoftwareApplication, ProfilePage or Course. Needs url. validate = Validate JSON-LD for rich results. Needs jsonld. product_page = Check an existing ecommerce product page (price, stock, merchant listing fields). To write Product JSON-LD use generate with type Product. Needs url.

jsonld.description: The JSON-LD as text, with or without the <script> tag.

url.description: Full address of the page, for example https://example.com/pricing.
